messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] mec on interactions
parts:
this seems to be an extention of the mec model/formulation as discussed
in the JRSS-C paper. This is not implemented, but doable. you should be
able to do that using 'rgeneric', see inla.doc("rgeneric")

H

On Tue, 2018-03-20 at 05:06 -0700, Erica ponzi wrote:
> Hi everyone,
>
> I have the following model and would like to implement a 'mec' model
> on the exposure variable ('Expo'), but taking into account that the
> regression coefficients vary among the different groups (ID_OMICS).
> Just using the 'mec' formula does not correct for the error in all
> the different groups but only if I have the simple case f(Expo)
> without the interaction. In practice I' d like to correct all the
> betas for Expo for each ID_OMICS group and not just the overall
> effect of Expo. Any ideas on how I could manage this?
>
>
> formula <- Omic ~ f(ID, model = 'iid') + f(wave, model = 'iid') +
> f(ID_OMICS, Expo, model="iid")+
> f(ID_OMICS3, Age, model="iid") +
> f(ID_OMICS4, sex, model="iid") +
> f(ID_OMICS5, BMI, model="iid")
>
>
> Thank you!
